card.name: Opening quote in CREATE TABLE columns
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or quote that begins a column list in a SQL CREATE TABLE or INSERT statement, just before a column name such as id. Also weaker on commas between column definitions.

modes.label: Column list opener
modes.description: The quote or parenthesis right after a table name in CREATE TABLE, where the first column name is expected.

modes.label: Between column definitions
modes.description: Commas or quotes between column definitions, where the next column name comes.
